result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 2 (Government), Article 2 (Administrative Code) covering city budget, City Attorney, Personnel Director and Purchasing Agent provisions, retrieved from a page URL about the algorithmic rent-pricing prohibition.
result.notes: This part contains only San Diego administrative code provisions (budget preparation, library appropriations, City Attorney, Civil Service, purchasing and recycled-products policy). None address rent increase limits, just cause eviction, security deposits, screening fees, screening restrictions or algorithmic rent setting. The algorithmic rent-pricing text (Division 11, "Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price Fixing") named in the source URL does not appear in this part, so no rules were extracted.
